# `try_to_binary`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

This is a special version of `to_binary` that performs the same operation, but returns a NULL value instead of raising an error if the conversion cannot be performed.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
try_to_binary(str[, fmt])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.3.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- try_to_binary, example 1
> SELECT try_to_binary('abc', 'utf-8');
abc
```

```sql
-- try_to_binary, example 2
> select try_to_binary('a!', 'base64');
NULL
```

```sql
-- try_to_binary, example 3
> select try_to_binary('abc', 'invalidFormat');
NULL
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.3.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
